findings.issue: solc immutables read as 0, so the E-CLP parameters are all zero and the math folds into an unconditional revert after the balance checks; the three core functions of the pool are bare reverts in this text and onSwap requires caller == 0.

notes: Reviewed against GyroECLPPool.sol, GyroECLPMath, SignedFixedPoint and the Balancer v3 BalancerPoolToken base. All 36 ABI functions were read (1,012 lines). Because the E-CLP parameters are immutables (read as 0), computeBalance, computeInvariant and onSwap reduce to their input checks (array bounds, int256 conversion with SafeCastOverflowedUintToInt 0x24775e06, the signed-overflow test of x + y, the invariant bound) followed by an unconditional revert, so the GyroECLPMath code cannot be compared; the remaining functions (ERC-20 forwarding to the Vault, permit, getters of pool data from the Vault with their ABI decode/encode loops, EIP-712) are faithful. The pack lists no source loop in the reached code; the 22 whiles are ABI decode/encode loops (calldata/returndata arrays, P7 for the pure copies). No execution run.
summary: Faithful, but most of the pool is lost to the artifact: with the immutable E-CLP parameters read as 0, computeBalance, computeInvariant and onSwap fold into unconditional reverts; the rest is plain Vault forwarding with ABI copy loops.
